fusions.name: Host to Host
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 7 damage, then it hops to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of the original damage. Holds up to 4 charges, and each kill gives one back. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Springing Bite
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles to the target, dealing 14 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Skip Step
fusions.desc: Carries you 3 tiles and raises your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds. A cloud of biters fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitten Along
fusions.desc: As you move, a bite leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 6 damage, then hops to 2 more within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that. Once every 5 seconds.
